label: startup-code
notes: Reset/startup code, interrupt stubs, bank setup, cold/warm boot paths, hardware init, IVT installer. C000 segment at file 0xC0000 via port 0x16=0x01.

label: far-call-table-source
notes: 41 far-pointer entries copied to RAM [0200..029C] during vector install. Mostly DEF0:xxxx targets.

label: int21-validity-table
notes: Byte map from AH (00..5F) to dispatch slot index. 0xFF = unsupported.

label: int21-dispatch-table
notes: Word table of C000:xxxx handler offsets, indexed by validity slot.

label: int21-dispatch
notes: INT 21h entry: register save, validity check, dispatch, flag propagation, IRET.

label: def0-header
notes: Display-resource header or padding before first wrapper.

label: def0-wrappers
notes: Thin far-call wrappers: register save, inner call or INT 21h, restore, RETF.

label: diagnostic-banner
notes: Diagnostic 31BAB218 banner and keyboard check prompt.

label: warm-ram-signature
notes: 4-byte warm-RAM signature "218 " checked at boot against RAM [1000].

label: high-rom
notes: High ROM bank (port 0x17=0x00). Contains reset trampoline at 0xF6E30, reset vector at 0xFFFF0, and other resources TBD.

label: reset-trampoline
notes: CLI, port 0x16/0x17 writes, JMP FAR C000:0000.
